data.content_ref: inline:The neighbourhood's four post-hoc diagnostics (SRC_002 defense witness, SRC_004 fragility, SRC_003 suspend_reason, SRC_008 RESIDUE) are not separate: they are each a different projection of the same relation R = {(x, d): d is an accepted defender of x against some accepted attacker}. DefenseWitness greedily selects a subset of R; fragility counts which single-edge deletions break R; suspend_reason and RESIDUE classify nodes where R is empty or defeated. The covering principle is that R is the single causal invariant connecting all accepted and suspended nodes. REFUTED IF two graphs with identical relation R yield different labels for some node under grounded semantics, or if any of the four diagnostics can change while R is held fixed.
